cases.input: One settlement produces a statutory EUR entry and management USD entry with different accounts and recognition dates.
cases.expect: Both entries balance independently, share only pinned event correlation and record basis, FX and classification divergence.

cases.input: After the statutory ledger hard-closes, Cash-GL must be reclassified to Restricted-Cash while management is correct.
cases.expect: A linked statutory correction posts in the earliest open permitted later period or as an appended linked entry under an explicit authorityRef exception; original entry and every emitted balance remain immutable; management is unchanged.

cases.input: A posting error is found while the ledger period remains open.
cases.expect: A linked reversal or adjustment is appended in the same ledger; original lines are unchanged.

cases.input: Account hierarchy is reorganised for the next fiscal year.
cases.expect: A successor Chart revision and effective Ledger Accounts preserve predecessor paths and historical interpretation.

cases.input: A statutory cash Ledger Account maps to one bank Financial Account for a declared entity and interval.
cases.expect: Mapping is stored as context-qualified correspondence and does not merge identities.

cases.input: Code 4000 is treated as globally identical across statutory and management ledgers.
cases.expect: Rejected because Ledger Account identity is ledger-, Chart-revision- and interval-scoped.

cases.input: A Posting targets a WM-ECO-015 bank account directly.
cases.expect: Rejected; Posting must target a Ledger Account governed by the effective Chart revision.

cases.input: A statutory debit offsets a management credit to satisfy balancing.
cases.expect: Rejected because no balancing scope spans ledgers.

cases.input: A statutory residual is plugged into a management entry.
cases.expect: Rejected; residuals post inside the same ledger under its pinned policy.

cases.input: The external settlement identifier is reused as the Journal Entry identity in two ledgers.
cases.expect: Rejected; correlation never replaces ledger-local entry identity.

cases.input: A successor accounting policy rewrites prior posted lines.
cases.expect: Rejected; the new policy is effective-dated and history changes only through linked corrections or restatement.

cases.input: A closed statutory period is silently reopened and the original entry edited.
cases.expect: Rejected; explicit exception or later-period correction is required.

cases.input: Correcting the statutory sibling automatically changes management.
cases.expect: Rejected; correction authority and timing are per ledger.

cases.input: A correction overwrites the closed-period WM-ECO-017 balance.
cases.expect: Rejected; closed balance is immutable and later assertions carry new as-of context.

cases.input: Bank position and GL balance are stored as one authoritative object.
cases.expect: Rejected; treasury/custody position and per-ledger GL balance remain distinct.

cases.input: The Enterprise profile creates a Ledger Account key.
cases.expect: Rejected as stealth mastership.

cases.input: Deleting a correspondence removes a source entry or account.
cases.expect: Rejected; profile bindings never cascade-delete masters.

cases.input: One ledger has overlapping effective adoptions of two Charts.
cases.expect: Rejected; one Chart adoption per ledger instant.

cases.input: Adoption closure predates an already-posted entry.
cases.expect: Rejected; supersession is prospective and preserves posted pins.

cases.input: Ledger Account narrows to a policy lineage different from effective adoption.
cases.expect: Rejected; narrowing must remain in adopted lineage and adoption governs.

cases.input: Unchanged node continues across a successor Chart revision.
cases.expect: Stable ledgerAccountId and balance series continue; predecessorRef resolves.

cases.input: Two Ledger Account versions for one ledger and node overlap.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: Two accounts share a code simultaneously in one ledger.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: A second backing account overlaps for the same context.
cases.expect: Rejected; at most one effective backing per context.

cases.input: New posting uses a suspended revision while a pre-suspension entry is reread.
cases.expect: New posting rejected; prior pin remains valid and unchanged.

cases.input: Chart is retired while adoption remains effective.
cases.expect: Rejected absent no effective adoption or successor adoption.

cases.input: Within-threshold residual is left unposted.
cases.expect: Rejected; residual posts to designated same-ledger account and total is exactly zero.

cases.input: Balancing uses an undeclared scope dimension.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: Rate revision recomputes prior translated posting in place.
cases.expect: Rejected; linked same-ledger correction required.

cases.input: Balance is keyed by currency without currencyRole.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: Open-period balance assertion is overwritten.
cases.expect: Rejected; successor assertion with own as-of and basis is emitted.

cases.input: Entry with accountingDate in hard-closed period is recorded without exception.
cases.expect: Rejected; use earliest open permitted later period or explicit authorityRef exception.

cases.input: Late entry is appended under explicit authorityRef exception.
cases.expect: Entry is linked and appended; original entry and emitted balances remain immutable.

cases.input: Authorised exception edits original closed entry.
cases.expect: Rejected; exception permits append only.

cases.input: Sibling sets differ in date and account without reason code.
cases.expect: Rejected; closed-vocabulary reason and both policy pins required.

cases.input: One event correlates to two entries in one ledger and one in another.
cases.expect: Grouped by eventRef and ledgerRef; each entry balances alone; divergence is set-level.

cases.input: Close state is asserted outside LedgerPeriod.
cases.expect: Rejected; LedgerPeriod is the sole close-state master.

cases.input: A correspondence binding is superseded.
cases.expect: Prior binding remains profile-resolvable; local key is non-subject; no source master changes.
